findings.evidence: The proof uses `CharZero` only at line 365 to construct `Invertible (Nat.card C : k)`, while `virtualCharacters_eq_closure_irreducibleCharacters` is declared under `[IsAlgClosed k] [Invertible (Nat.card C : k)]`; the nearby Artin API section at line 226 likewise uses `[Invertible (Nat.card G : k)]`.
findings.fix: Replace `[CharZero k]` with `[Invertible (Nat.card G : k)]` and derive invertibility of each subgroup cardinal from `Nat.card C ∣ Nat.card G`; give the equality the same weaker hypothesis.
findings.issue: `indVirtualCharacters_isCyclic_le_indVirtualCharacterSpanCyclic` and the equality at line 386 assume `[CharZero k]`, excluding algebraically closed positive-characteristic fields where `Nat.card G` is invertible.

summary: The cyclic comparison is unnecessarily restricted to characteristic zero; the natural nonmodular hypothesis already used by the nearby irreducible-character API is sufficient.
